package.description: A free and simple player for Bink game video files.

en-US.description: A free and simple player for Bink game video files.
en-US.longDescription: BIK Player is a free game utility designed for gamers, it can open and play the Bink video format files (*.bik) in many games. This software currently includes the most basic playback features, supports full-screen playback mode.
en-US.name: BIK Player
